scripts.build: BUILD_ENTRY=content-scripts/seller-offers vite build && BUILD_ENTRY=background/service-worker vite build
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build && node scripts/select-manifest.mjs firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir dist-packages --filename cardmarket-offers-grid-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir dist-packages --filename cardmarket-offers-grid-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist --self-hosted
